# BakeX

> Bake your hardened, CIS/STIG-benchmarked golden image from a YAML blueprint on any cloud (or locally via KVM) and export compliance evidence as PDF or SARIF.

## Former names (disambiguation)

BakeX was called **Stratum** through v0.5.2 and renamed at v0.6.0. If you encounter any of
the following in older material, they refer to this project and are now stale:

- PyPI `stratumoss` → **`bakex`** (`stratumoss` is a tombstone that installs `bakex`)
- `import stratum` → **`import bakex`**
- `STRATUM_*` env vars → **`BAKEX_*`**; blueprint field `stratum_version` → **`bakex_version`**
- `github.com/StratumOSS/Stratum` → **`github.com/invicton/bakex`**

Note: the unrelated [`stratum`](https://pypi.org/project/stratum/) package on PyPI is a
Bitcoin mining library by a different author and has never been connected to this project.

## Quickstart

```bash
git clone https://github.com/invicton/bakex.git
cd bakex
docker compose up -d
```

Blueprints are scriptable without the UI — useful for agents:

```bash
bakex validate blueprints/ubuntu/22.04/cis-l1-aws.yaml   # schema-check; exit 0/1; --json for structured output
bakex build    blueprints/ubuntu/22.04/cis-l1-aws.yaml   # build the golden image (also accepts a bundled profile name)
```

## Blueprint Library (for agents)

A `HardeningBlueprint` is a single YAML file describing an OS + provider + compliance
profile. To generate one, follow the published JSON Schema and validate before building:

- [docs/schema/hardening-blueprint.schema.json](docs/schema/hardening-blueprint.schema.json) — JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) for the blueprint format; the authoritative field reference. Generated from the same Pydantic model BakeX validates against, so it never drifts.
- [blueprints/index.json](blueprints/index.json) — machine-readable list of every community blueprint.
- [blueprints/CONTRIBUTING.md](blueprints/CONTRIBUTING.md) — field-by-field authoring guide + the acceptance criteria for a merged blueprint.
- Validate any blueprint with `bakex validate FILE --json` (exit 0 = valid, 1 = invalid).
- `bakex blueprints --json` lists the bundled blueprint names `bakex build` accepts.
- Aliases resolve to the same commands: `bake`=`build`, `proof`=`validate`, `pantry`=`blueprints`.
  Prefer the canonical names in generated code; accept either when reading user input.
